settings.activationCostLabelHint: Text in spell descriptions that enables the Cast button. Case-insensitive. Built-in aliases: “Koszt aktywacji”, “Activation Cost”.
settings.enableCurrencyHint: If unchecked, currency UI and hooks are disabled.
settings.enableItemSendHint: If unchecked, sending/transferring items is disabled.
settings.enableTalentSearchHint: If unchecked, the Talent Search tool is hidden and inactive.
settings.enableRequestRollsHint: If unchecked, the Request a Roll tool is hidden and inactive.
settings.enableResultSpenderHint: Adds interactive spending of Advantage, Threat, Triumph, and Despair to FFG roll chat messages.
settings.resultSpenderMenuHint: Add campaign-specific ways to spend narrative dice results and define their costs.

resultSpender.playerRestriction: Players can spend only Advantage and Triumph from their own/controlled rolls. Threat and Despair can be spent only by a GM.
resultSpender.notSpendable: This chat message does not contain spendable FFG narrative dice results.
resultSpender.noPermission: You cannot spend results from this roll.
resultSpender.gmOnlyNegative: Only a GM can spend Threat or Despair.
resultSpender.noGM: No active GM is available to authorize result spending.
resultSpender.optionMissing: This spending option no longer exists. Reopen Spend Results and try again.
resultSpender.busy: This roll is being updated. Try again in a moment.
resultSpender.failed: Could not spend the result. See the console for details.
resultSpender.noOptions: No spending options are configured for the available results.
resultSpender.settingsIntro: Built-in options follow the standard result-spending tables for social encounters and combat. The module automatically selects the correct set depending on whether a started Combat is active on the current scene. GM custom options remain available in both modes.
resultSpender.builtInHint: Built-in options are selected automatically for the current context. They do not apply mechanical effects automatically; they track the spend and announce the chosen effect in chat.
resultSpender.customHint: Add your own result, cost, name, and optional description. Threat and Despair options are automatically GM-only.
resultSpender.nameRequired: Every custom spending option needs a name.
resultSpender.invalidCost: Cost must be a whole number from 1 to 99.
resultSpender.invalidCustom: One of the custom spending options is invalid.

socialNextAllyBoost.title: Boost the next active ally
socialNextAllyBoost.description: Add a Boost die to the next check made by the next allied active character.

socialNoticeDetail.title: Notice an important detail
socialNoticeDetail.description: Notice one important detail in the ongoing encounter that can provide a situational advantage.

socialLearnStrengthFlaw.title: Learn the target's Strength or Flaw
socialLearnStrengthFlaw.description: Learn either the Strength or the Flaw of the targeted character.

socialTargetBoost.title: Boost the target's next check
socialTargetBoost.description: Add a Boost die to the targeted character's next check.

socialAnyAllyBoost.title: Boost any ally's next check
socialAnyAllyBoost.description: Add a Boost die to any allied character's next check, including the active character.

socialLearnDesireFear.title: Learn the target's Desire or Fear
socialLearnDesireFear.description: Learn either the Desire or the Fear of the targeted character.

socialConcealGoal.title: Conceal your true goal
socialConcealGoal.description: Successfully conceal your true goal during the encounter.

socialLearnTrueGoal.title: Learn the target's true goal
socialLearnTrueGoal.description: Learn the target's true goal, if they have one.

socialLearnMotivation.title: Learn any Motivation facet
socialLearnMotivation.description: With GM approval, learn any one Motivation facet of a character in the encounter.

socialUpgradeTargetDifficulty.title: Upgrade the target's next difficulty
socialUpgradeTargetDifficulty.description: Upgrade the difficulty of the targeted character's next check once.

socialUpgradeAllyAbility.title: Upgrade an ally's next check
socialUpgradeAllyAbility.description: Upgrade the ability of any allied character's next check once, including the active character.

socialDoVital.title: Do something vital
socialDoVital.description: Create a major narrative opening, such as getting everyone's attention or distracting guards so allies can act.

socialSufferStrain.title: Active character suffers strain
socialSufferStrain.description: The active character suffers 1 strain for each Threat spent. If the effect is paid with Despair, the character suffers 1 strain.

socialDistracted.title: Become distracted or sidetracked
socialDistracted.description: The active character is briefly distracted; this might block an ability requiring a maneuver on their next turn or drag them into an unwanted conversation.

socialRevealStrengthFlaw.title: Reveal your own Strength or Flaw
socialRevealStrengthFlaw.description: The active character accidentally reveals their own Strength or Flaw.

socialTargetGetsBoost.title: Give the target a Boost
socialTargetGetsBoost.description: Add a Boost die to the targeted character's next check.

socialAllySetback.title: Setback on an ally's next action
socialAllySetback.description: The active character or an allied character suffers a Setback die on their next action.

socialRevealDesireFear.title: Reveal your own Desire or Fear
socialRevealDesireFear.description: The active character accidentally reveals their own Desire or Fear.

socialRevealGoal.title: Reveal your true goal
socialRevealGoal.description: The active character accidentally reveals their true goal in the encounter.

socialRevealAllyMotivation.title: Reveal an ally's Motivation
socialRevealAllyMotivation.description: The active character accidentally reveals one Motivation facet of an ally.

socialFalseMotivation.title: Learn a false Motivation
socialFalseMotivation.description: The active character learns a false Motivation facet of the target and believes it to be true.

socialUpgradeAllyDifficulty.title: Upgrade an ally's next difficulty
socialUpgradeAllyDifficulty.description: Upgrade the difficulty of an allied character's next check or the active character's next check once.

socialLoseNextRound.title: Get embroiled in irrelevant events
socialLoseNextRound.description: The active character becomes so caught up in irrelevant events that they cannot do anything important during the next round.

combatNextAllyBoost.title: Boost the next ally
combatNextAllyBoost.description: Add a Boost die to the next allied character's next check.

combatNoticeDetail.title: Notice an important detail
combatNoticeDetail.description: Notice one important point in the conflict, such as a door control panel or a weak point on an armored vehicle.

combatCriticalInjury.title: Inflict a Critical Injury
combatCriticalInjury.description: On a successful attack that deals damage past soak, trigger a Critical Injury. The required Advantage cost can vary by weapon.

combatItemQuality.title: Activate an Item Quality
combatItemQuality.description: Activate a relevant item quality. The required Advantage cost can vary by quality.

combatFreeManeuver.title: Immediate free maneuver
combatFreeManeuver.description: Immediately perform a free maneuver without exceeding the limit of two maneuvers per turn.

combatTargetBoost.title: Boost the target's next check
combatTargetBoost.description: Add a Boost die to the targeted character's next check.

combatAnyAllyBoost.title: Boost any ally's next check
combatAnyAllyBoost.description: Add a Boost die to any allied character's next check, including the active character.

combatNegateDefense.title: Negate an enemy's Defense
combatNegateDefense.description: Negate the targeted enemy's Defense until the end of the current round, whether it comes from cover, equipment, or a guarded stance.

combatIgnoreEnvironment.title: Ignore environmental penalties
combatIgnoreEnvironment.description: Ignore penalizing environmental effects until the end of the active character's next turn.

combatDisableTarget.title: Disable the target or a piece of gear
combatDisableTarget.description: When dealing damage, disable the opponent or one piece of their gear instead of dealing wounds or strain. The player and GM should agree on the exact effect.

combatGainDefense.title: Gain +1 Defense
combatGainDefense.description: Gain +1 melee or ranged Defense until the end of the active character's next turn.

combatDropWeapon.title: Force the target to drop a weapon
combatDropWeapon.description: Force the targeted character to drop one melee or ranged weapon they are wielding.

combatUpgradeTargetDifficulty.title: Upgrade the target's next difficulty
combatUpgradeTargetDifficulty.description: Upgrade the difficulty of the targeted character's next check once.

combatUpgradeAllyAbility.title: Upgrade an ally's next check
combatUpgradeAllyAbility.description: Upgrade the ability of any allied character's next check once, including the active character.

combatDoVital.title: Do something vital
combatDoVital.description: Create a major combat effect, such as shooting nearby blast-door controls to seal them shut.

combatInitiativeManeuver.title: Free maneuver before combat begins
combatInitiativeManeuver.description: On an Initiative check, immediately perform a free maneuver before combat begins.

combatDestroyEquipment.title: Destroy a piece of the target's equipment
combatDestroyEquipment.description: When dealing damage, destroy one piece of equipment the target is using, such as a weapon.

combatSufferStrain.title: Active character suffers strain
combatSufferStrain.description: The active character suffers 1 strain for each Threat spent. If the effect is paid with Despair, the character suffers 1 strain.

combatLoseManeuverBenefit.title: Lose the benefit of a prior maneuver
combatLoseManeuverBenefit.description: The active character loses the benefit of a prior maneuver, such as cover or a guarded stance, until they perform it again.

combatOpponentFreeManeuver.title: Opponent performs a free maneuver
combatOpponentFreeManeuver.description: An opponent may immediately perform one free maneuver as an incidental response to the active character's check.

combatTargetGetsBoost.title: Give the target a Boost
combatTargetGetsBoost.description: Add a Boost die to the targeted character's next check.

combatAllySetback.title: Setback on the next action
combatAllySetback.description: The active character or an allied character suffers a Setback die on their next action.

combatEnemyAdvantage.title: Grant the enemy a significant advantage
combatEnemyAdvantage.description: The active character gives an enemy a significant advantage in the encounter, such as damaging an environmental feature needed for escape.

combatOutOfAmmo.title: Weapon runs out of ammunition
combatOutOfAmmo.description: The active character's weapon immediately runs out of ammunition and cannot be used for the rest of the encounter.

combatUpgradeAllyDifficulty.title: Upgrade an ally's next difficulty
combatUpgradeAllyDifficulty.description: Upgrade the difficulty of an allied character's next check or the active character's next check once.

combatDamageWeaponTool.title: Damage a weapon or tool
combatDamageWeaponTool.description: A tool, Brawl weapon, or Melee weapon used by the active character becomes damaged.

resultSpender.invalidVariableCost: An invalid result-spending cost was selected.

automation.strainUnavailable: {actor} does not have a Strain track, so this effect cannot be applied automatically.
